import requests, re, os, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def rd(c): return open(f"out/{c}.fa").read().strip()
def rc(s): return s[::-1].translate(str.maketrans("ACGTN","TGCAN"))
bg=rd("bg1")+rd("bg2")+rd("bg3")
freq=np.array([bg.count(b) for b in "ACGT"],float); freq/=freq.sum()
d=requests.get("https://jaspar.elixir.no/api/v1/matrix/MA0767.2/?format=json",timeout=40).json()
M=np.array([d["pfm"][b] for b in "ACGT"],float)
W=np.log2(((M+1.0)/(M.sum(0,keepdims=True)+4.0))/freq[:,None]); w=M.shape[1]
IX={b:i for i,b in enumerate("ACGT")}
def scores(seq):
    lut=np.full(256,-1,np.int64)
    for b,i in IX.items(): lut[ord(b)]=i
    code=lut[np.frombuffer(seq.encode(),np.uint8)]
    valid=code>=0; code=np.where(valid,code,0); n=len(seq)-w+1
    sc=np.zeros(n); ok=np.ones(n,bool)
    for j in range(w):
        sc+=W[code[j:j+n], j]; ok&=valid[j:j+n]
    sc[~ok]=-999; return sc
bgs=np.concatenate([scores(bg),scores(rc(bg))]); bgs=bgs[bgs>-900]
thr4=np.quantile(bgs,1-1e-4); thr5=np.quantile(bgs,1-1e-5)

LOCI=[("gcm  (positive control: functional Gcm site, Ransick & Davidson 2012)", rd("gcm_win"),17600,-4220),
      ("pks1 (positive control: Gcm site in mutagenised -1.5 kb CRM, Calestani & Rogers 2010)", rd("pks1_win"),10000,-1437),
      ("gatae (test locus: whole regulatory domain)", rd("gatae_win"),20000,None)]
fig,axes=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(13,9.5),sharey=True)
summary=[]
for ax,(title,s,tss,fs) in zip(axes,LOCI):
    f=scores(s); r=scores(rc(s))[::-1]
    best=np.maximum(f,np.r_[r[:len(f)]])
    x=(np.arange(len(best))-tss)/1000.0
    ax.plot(x,best,lw=0.5,color="#4a4a4a")
    ex=[]
    for m in re.finditer("(?=(ATGCGG[AG][CT]))", s): ex.append((m.start(),m.group(1),"+"))
    for m in re.finditer("(?=([AG][CT]CCGCAT))", s): ex.append((m.start(),rc(m.group(1)),"-"))
    for pos,word,st in ex:
        col = "#c0392b" if word[6]=="G" else "#e08214"
        ax.plot((pos-tss)/1000.0, best[min(pos,len(best)-1)], "o", ms=9, mfc=col, mec="k", zorder=5)
        ax.annotate(f"{word}\n{(pos-tss)/1000:+.2f} kb", ((pos-tss)/1000.0, best[min(pos,len(best)-1)]),
                    textcoords="offset points", xytext=(0,10), ha="center", fontsize=8)
        summary.append(dict(locus=title.split()[0], rel_tss=pos-tss, word=word, strand=st, pwm=round(float(best[min(pos,len(best)-1)]),2)))
    ax.axhline(thr4,color="#2980b9",ls="--",lw=1); ax.axhline(thr5,color="#8e44ad",ls=":",lw=1.2)
    ax.axvline(0,color="k",lw=0.8)
    ax.set_title(title,fontsize=10,loc="left")
    ax.set_ylabel("GCM2 PWM score (bits)")
    ax.set_ylim(-5, 17)
axes[0].text(0.01,0.93,f"blue dashed = genomic p=1e-4 ({thr4:.1f});  purple dotted = p=1e-5 ({thr5:.1f})",
             transform=axes[0].transAxes,fontsize=8)
axes[2].set_xlabel("position relative to annotated transcription start (kb)")
fig.suptitle("GCM motif landscape of the gatae, pks and gcm loci in Strongylocentrotus purpuratus\n"
             "red = ATGCGGGY (R=G, the variant used by both functional sites); orange = ATGCGGAY (R=A)",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
S=pd.DataFrame(summary); S.to_csv("out/consensus_hits.csv",index=False); print(S.to_string(index=False))
print("\nthresholds", round(thr4,2), round(thr5,2))
